description: Replaces Chicken's A-skin for Miss Bloomie from the popular animation, Fundamental Paper Education! Made by Sip/Hexsprite, Original character by Kaaatie! I decided to go for the A-skin for this one, since Chicken's B and C-skins are difficult. So, for the players that are not that good at the game, you don't have to suffer anymore!
name: Miss Bloomie!
